confidenceDefinitions.high: Multiple independent 2026 sources support the player, or an explicit 2026 candidate designation is reinforced by a demonstrated power-law profile.
confidenceDefinitions.medium: At least one credible current 2026 source explicitly supports a league-winning or Exodia-style ceiling with a documented role, efficiency or positional-edge case.
confidenceDefinitions.low: Reserved for speculative cases; no low-confidence candidates are included in this release to avoid diluting the pill.

eligibility: The player has a credible path to a championship-shifting advantage over this league's positional replacement level.
The upside would be usable in a managed weekly lineup rather than relying only on unpredictable spike weeks.
The ceiling case is supported by current 2026 evidence, not merely by a generic sleeper, value or risk tag.
Early-round players remain eligible when their ceiling can materially separate from the rest of the position.
Late-round players require a plausible role-expansion or contingency path to becoming an every-week starter.
interpretation: leagueWinner is an informational ceiling profile, not a projection, guarantee or instruction to reach.
The profile complements median projections, VORP, tiers, VONA and roster construction.
Risk and injury remain separate discretionary chips and are not numerically offset by this label.
A high-confidence label means stronger evidence for the ceiling thesis, not certainty that the ceiling will occur.
implementationRules: Do not use leagueWinner in candidate scores, sorting, tie-breaks, roster simulations, need calculations, ADP forecasts or wait-versus-now logic.
Do not infer leagueWinner automatically from tag, note, ADP, projection disagreement or player volatility.
Do not treat a missing leagueWinner field as a negative signal.
Render a compact LW pill for players with the field and expose confidence, archetypes, reasons and sources in the existing detail interaction.
caveats: Most source lists assume one-QB home leagues; quarterback rationales were adjusted qualitatively for this league's Superflex replacement level, but source rankings were not copied.
Expert candidate lists are not calibrated probabilities and have substantial miss rates.
Projection-source disagreement is epistemic uncertainty and was not treated as a player ceiling.

The 37 candidates are a curated union of strong current cases plus a user watchlist, not a claim that 37 players will become league winners. Obvious top-10 ADP names are omitted so the label stays useful later in the draft.
News, depth charts and injuries remain time-sensitive and should be reviewed again immediately before the draft.

modelRefreshMethodology.vorp: modelPts minus the league-specific positional replacement value.
modelRefreshMethodology.staticOverallRank: VORP-first. FantasyPros and DraftSharks Superflex consensus can make only a capped tie-break adjustment; no standalone expert receives a fixed 30% weight.
modelRefreshMethodology.liveRecommendation: The app's completed-team utility and live roster/room state remain authoritative. ADP, age, outlooks, and league-winner labels are context unless the app explicitly models them.
modelRefreshMethodology.age: Integer age on the Aug. 22, 2026 draft date, computed from birthDate. DraftSharks birth dates are preferred; Sleeper is the fallback.
modelRefreshMethodology.outlook: Copyright-safe numeric summary, source link and a maximum-20-word DraftSharks Verdict excerpt. Existing user-authored notes and league-winner tags are preserved.
